title: Google Merchant listing
statusNote: Active. Requires the merchant to be the seller (Offer, not AggregateOffer); shipping/return markup precedence is below Merchant Center feeds/settings.
notes: Not checked: isbn is a Book property, so it is only valid when the node is also typed Book.
Not checked: offer price must be greater than 0.
Not checked: merchantReturnDays is required when returnPolicyCategory is MerchantReturnFiniteReturnWindow.
Not checked: returnShippingFeesAmount is required when returnFees is ReturnShippingFees.
Not checked: at most one value for sku, inProductGroupWithID, size, subjectOf, brand name, itemCondition and availability, and at most 10 certifications.
Product: name, image (repeated ImageObject/URL), offers (Offer) required.

Offer price must be > 0 (unlike product snippets); price or priceSpecification.price; priceCurrency (ISO 4217) required alongside whichever price is used. priceType=StrikethroughPrice marks list price (needs a current sale price too). validForMemberTier needs a regular price too (beta).

Specify at most one value for sku, inProductGroupWithID, size, subjectOf(3DModel), brand name; at most 10 certifications; only one value for itemCondition (NewCondition, RefurbishedCondition, UsedCondition) and availability. hasAdultConsideration: only https://schema.org/SexualContentConsideration supported. category accepts Text and CategoryCode (inCodeSet + codeValue). isbn only valid on Book (co-type with Product). 3DModel: encoding.contentUrl glTF .gltf/.glb.

Certification: issuedBy and name required; name supported values EPREL, Vehicle_CO2_Class, Vehicle_CO2_Class_Discharged_Battery; certificationIdentification required for EU energy labels; certificationRating.ratingValue required when used (bestRating/worstRating also required for EU energy ratings).

OfferShippingDetails is optional, but if used deliveryTime, shippingDestination, shippingRate (+currency, and value or maxValue) are required; shippingRate.currency must equal offer currency; one deliveryTime and one shippingRate per shippingDetails entry (repeat shippingDetails for multiple options).
QuantitativeValue for shipping needs minValue, maxValue (non-negative whole numbers) and unitCode DAY or d.
DefinedRegion: addressCountry required; addressRegion or postalCode (not both, not mixed); region/postal only for restricted countries (US, AU, JP regions;

MerchantReturnPolicy: applicableCountry (up to 50, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) and returnPolicyCategory (MerchantReturnFiniteReturnWindow | MerchantReturnNotPermitted | MerchantReturnUnlimitedWindow) required; merchantReturnDays Integer required for finite window; returnFees (FreeReturn | ReturnFeesCustomerResponsibility | ReturnShippingFees) recommended; returnShippingFeesAmount required only if non-zero fee (returnFees=ReturnShippingFees), and must not be used with FreeReturn/ReturnFeesCustomerResponsibility; returnMethod (ReturnAtKiosk, ReturnByMail, ReturnInStore) only recommended for finite/unlimited windows.
Precedence (strongest to weakest): Merchant Center product feeds, Content API settings, Merchant Center/Search Console settings, product-level markup, Organization-level markup.
